newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-ZILE TO RESIGN IF BUDGET NOT BALANCED-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-ZILE TO RESIGN IF BUDGET NOT BALANCED-REPORT.

text.p: Finance Minister Robert Zile has said he would resign if the new government does not keep to its plan of a balanced budget, Diena newspaper said on Thursday.
It quoted Zile as saying that the government may not be able to keep to its target due to an internal contradiction in the way the government was set up.
"The new government's principle is that each party is responsible for its sector and consequently will want more financing," he told the newspaper.
"Only one party is responsible for the government as a whole and this situation is objectively contradictory," he added.
He said that if the deficit-free budget principle was not followed then he would resign.
He said that if this happened, then either the conflict would bring down the whole government or it would get a new finance minister and carry on working.
